prompt: In many countries, a high proportion of young people who are released from prison commit further offences within a short period. What are the reasons for this, and how could the situation be improved?
essay:
It is a fact that many young criminals are committing the crime again very soon after they are released from the prison. This is a serious problem for the society and in this essay I will discuss why it is happening and what can we do about it.

Firstly, the main reason of this problem is that the young people can not find a job after the prison. No company wants to give a job to a person with a criminal record, so they do not have the money and they return to the crime for surviving. Secondly, the prison itself is a bad influence. Inside the prison the young person is meeting with the professional criminals and he is learning the bad things from them. Moreover, many of these young people are coming from the poor families and broken homes, so when they are released, nobody is supporting them and they go back to the same bad friends.

To solve this problem, the government should do several things. Firstly, the government should give more education and training inside the prison, so the young people can learn a skill. Secondly, the punishment should be more strict, because if the young people are afraid of the prison they will not commit the crime again. In addition, the society should not discriminate these people and the companies should give them a chance.

In conclusion, the reasons of the reoffending are the unemployment, the bad influence of the prison and the family problems, and the solutions are the education, the strict punishment and the second chance from the society. If we do these things, the young people will have a better future.
title: Why young offenders return to crime
